title: dev/handoff.py request projection and catch: roll-call line, generated pending-user list, H.request-unprojected and H.request-unlinked

delivers: dev/handoff.py reads the task_plan 'Open requests' section and the untracked request ledger (format and path from CL4 E1/E2; absent ledger = no captured requests, reported, not an error) and emits finding H.request-unprojected (P1: a captured request with no task_plan item and no disposition) and H.request-unlinked (P2: an open item with no GitHub issue link)
